answers.core: This is a core part of exporting html5 projects.
answers.workaround:
I expect the feature to be frequently used, as many hosting servers do not compress data transparently.

For example, looking at a few godot games on itch.io, only the wasm file is sent compressed by the server.  Taking two random games, compressing their pck file saved quite a bit of bandwidth.  (56mb -> 36mb, 21mb -> 15mb).

title: Support loading compressed files in the Web export
